personality_one_liner: A sharp, utilitarian financial tool that feels like a modern ledger—precise, trustworthy, and free of generic SaaS noise.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native rhythm. Ensure intentional whitespace around content blocks, avoiding cramped edges. Hit targets min 44x44pt.

do's: Sticky headers over scrolling content (like expense list)
Featured cards overlay when sitting on image/gradient backdrop
dont's: Areas requiring high legibility of fine print without a solid tint fallback

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: High-level spending summary and quick access to recent expenses.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for total balance and bento cards, spinner for list
states.empty: No expenses logged this month. Show illustration of empty desk and a prominent 'Scan your first receipt' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load summary. Text error with retry button.

screens.layout: Full-width hero balance card at the top displaying total spend using Space Grotesk. Underneath, a bento grid for quick insights (e.g., top category). Below that, a list of 'Recent Expenses' using inset tonal panels (surfaceSecondary on surface) and a ledger spine (hairline vertical line connecting items).

screens.name: Scan Flow
screens.purpose: Capture and auto-extract receipt data accurately.

states.loading: AI extraction spinner overlaid on captured image
states.error: Could not detect details. Manual entry form shown.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera viewfinder taking primary screen area. Translucent, safe-area aligned top/bottom controls. Centered reticle/bracket overlay. Once captured, shifts to a bottom-sheet driven review screen: top half shows the cropped receipt image, bottom sheet contains auto-filled form (surfaceTertiary) fields for manual edit.

screens.name: Expenses List
screens.purpose: Browse, filter, and search all historical expenses.

states.empty: Illustration indicating no matches found with the current filters. Clear filters button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header with horizontal scrollable filter chips (Categories/Projects). Tonal list rows (roughly 72dp high) with right-aligned tabular amounts in JetBrains Mono or Space Grotesk. Hairline dividers (0.5pt) separating rows.

screens.name: Expense Detail
screens.purpose: View full receipt and edit categorized data.

states.error: Failed to save changes. Inline error text.

screens.layout: Receipt image hero (top 40% of screen) with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to protect header icons. Bottom 60% is a scrollable form in surfaceSecondary with 1px borders for input fields. Sticky primary 'Save Changes' CTA at the bottom in a safe-area respecting fixed container.

screens.name: Reports Analytics
screens.purpose: Visualize spending habits and export for tax purposes.

states.empty: Not enough data to generate reports.

screens.layout: Segmented controls (Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly) pinned under a glass header. Minimalist bar charts (using brandTertiary moss green). A prominent 'Export CSV' button anchored at the bottom using a fixed container with top fade-shadow.

empty_state_desk.alt: empty minimalist desk planner top view

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: No blues, purples, or generic AI-tech colors anywhere. Utilize the defined Moss Green, Terracotta, and Bone White palette to establish a trustworthy, utilitarian finance tool.
Typography constraints: Use Space Grotesk strictly for all tabular data, amounts, and prominent metrics (balances). Use Plus Jakarta Sans for UI labels, body, and standard text.
Implement 'Inset Tonal Panels': Use hairline dividers (0.5pt) and tonal background separation instead of heavy drop shadows to structure the layout.
Ensure all numbers align to a strict baseline rhythm, and use JetBrains Mono or Space Grotesk tabular figures for lists to maintain vertical digit alignment.
The primary Scan action should be an elevated FAB positioned centrally in the bottom navigation bar.
Implement the gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) pattern anywhere text overlays an image, especially on the Expense Detail receipt hero.
For the Scan Flow, ensure the manual entry fallback is immediately accessible without interrupting the primary camera flow. Use a bottom sheet to slide up the extraction results.
